name: plot-widget
title: Visualization Widgets
description: An app that contains different plots with d3.

widgets.name: Tile Plot of contributions
widgets.description: A GitHub-style chart that displays the intensity of contributions of different members over time.

widgets.name: Histogram Plot
widgets.description: A histogram plot that allows the user to show contribution frequencies.

widgets.name: Contribution over time
widgets.description: A bar chart grouped by either days, months, etc. showing the contributed time to issues defined in a query.
